proposed.rationale: All four cups have an explicit handle attribute with value 'none', satisfying the negation mode requirement for cups explicitly without a handle.
Product 100408047 is a bowl made of glass and product 100413383 is a bowl made of porcelain, providing one verified product in each branch of the glass OR porcelain either_or mode.
All five jugs have explicit capacity values expressed in L, enabling unit conversion to ml or cl. Capacities are 0.70L, 1L, 1.6L, 1.2L, and 1.8L respectively.
Each vase has explicit height and distinct diameter values, satisfying the dimension mode requirement with both axes retained.
All five drinking glasses have explicit pack_count and capacity per glass facts, satisfying the pack_capacity mode.
Products 100455704 and 100455702 are explicitly solid_oak tables; product 100478281 is explicitly an oak_veneer table, providing the required solid-oak positive and oak-veneer contrast.
All five pans have an explicit induction attribute set to 'true', confirming compatibility with induction cooktops.

Product 100468229 is a pan explicitly made of stainless_steel_aluminium and explicitly has coating value 'none', satisfying both the stainless steel and no-coating exclusion criteria. It is also explicitly induction compatible.
Product 100396731 is a jug with explicit material (porcelain) and explicit capacity (1600ml / 1.6L), allowing one correct attribute to be added at a time for specificity testing.

Product 100468230 (pan) has a member price of 499.95 DKK (<500) and a regular price of 1499.95 DKK (>=500), satisfying the conditional price positive. Product 100456332 (pan) has a public price of 299.95 DKK (<500 DKK) with no conditional pricing, serving as the unconditional under-500-DKK contrast pan.
